name: いま読んでいる本を開く
prompt:
Create one polished Japanese currently-reading book card based on the exact 390 by 220 native preview in reference 2. Preserve the original Fable screen's book and action from reference 1, but exclude its phone chrome, page header, member row, and tabs. The editable source is a white 390 by 220 component with a title row, one exact book-cover image, Japanese title and author, and one open-book action.

Use a pure white canvas and a white card with a fine neutral gray outline, compact spacing, and no tinted surface fills, no mint, no colored wash, and no colored shadows. Put forest green #1F6444 only on the primary open-book action, using a flat solid fill and white label. Keep all supporting text near-black or gray. Retain the original cover artwork from reference 3 exactly as supplied; do not redraw, recolor, crop differently, or add another badge. Its small bookmark glyph is part of the protected artwork.

Keep the component at 390 by 220. Place the Japanese heading いま読んでいる本 at x20 y8. Place the cover at x20 y62, size83 by127. Place the book title モンテ・クリスト伯 at x120 y74, author アレクサンドル・デュマ at x120 y114, and green action button at x120 y154, size250 by38, with the exact label 電子書籍を開く. Use Meiryo Regular/Bold with a clear hierarchy, readable Japanese, and no extra controls or copy. Reference 2 controls localized wording and exact geometry. Reference 1 controls original book identity and anatomy. Reference 3 is the unchanged exact cover media. Keep the layout simple and high contrast with broad white space around the content; do not expand it into a full app screen.
reviewNotes: White surfaces and exact cover direction are retained; flatten the green CTA to respect the no-tint preference and move the heading to the native top anchor. Exact cover pixel preservation is unverified.
